departments.name: Oral Medicine & Radiology
departments.about: Welcome to the Department of Oral Medicine & Radiology. We are dedicated to providing state-of-the-art dental clinical care alongside high-quality training and education for both undergraduate and postgraduate scholars. Specializing in oral diagnostics, advanced imaging (CBCT, digital radiography), and non-surgical management of head and neck conditions.
departments.infrastructure: Our department is equipped with modern dental chairs, digital radiography, specialized clinics, and dedicated student laboratories.
departments.clinical_services: Specialist consultation, therapeutic clinical services, minor surgical therapies, and follow-ups.
departments.research_activities: Active clinical trials, molecular research publications, and department-level thesis presentations.

news_events.title: National Oral Health & Hygiene Workshop 2026
news_events.content: GDC Dibrugarh successfully hosted the National Oral Health Workshop. The event saw participation from dental specialists across North-East India focusing on modern community outreach techniques, pediatric prophylaxis, and tea garden fluoride mapping.

news_events.title: Advanced CBCT Dental Imaging Wing Inaugurated
news_events.content: The Department of Oral Medicine & Radiology has officially inaugurated its new 3D Cone Beam Computed Tomography (CBCT) imaging suite. This facility will provide premium diagnostic accuracy for implant placements, root canal anatomies, and maxillofacial fractures at highly subsidized rates.

news_events.title: BDS Annual Term Exam Registration Dates Announced
news_events.content: Affiliating University (Dibrugarh University) has announced exam registration schedules for the BDS professional exams. Online forms can be submitted from June 12 onwards. Students must clear library dues before obtaining admit cards.
